description:
## [1.13.0-dev.1](https://github.com/jordanwoodson/lurk-morphe-patches/compare/v1.12.0...v1.13.0-dev.1) (2026-10-22)

### Kick

#### ✨ New Features

* add an opt-in FingerprintJS block to **Disable analytics**
* add **Chat keywords**
* add **Chat timestamps** and Chat text size
* add **Fill screen**
* add **Hide mature-content warning**
* add **Show exact counts**

#### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* keep injected calls from being dropped above v15
* list **Bypass VOD ad sessions** under Playback
* log setting and 7TV load failures as warnings
* refuse Hermes edits that a jump or switch case lands inside
* say in Manager that JavaScript patches turn off Kick's updates
* say what 7TV can learn from **Third-party emotes**
* select tipping, upsell and Clips hiding with their switch off
* **show deleted messages** without telling Kick's server

#### 🔧 Improvements

* reuse the prepared Hermes bundle across cold starts
* skip chat bridge messages when 7TV is off

### Rumble

#### ✨ New Features

* add **Background audio by default**
* add **Default playback speed**
* add **Disable tracking SDKs**
* add **Hide comments and related videos**
* add **Hide Join and Shop buttons**
* add **Hide premium-only videos**
* add **Player gestures**
* hide Boosted videos and Home ad sections with **Block ads**
* select **Hide Shorts**, tipping, autoplay and quality by default

#### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* describe what **Unlock Premium** does and doesn't do
* keep push notifications with **Block cookie notice**
* let Compose skip the refresh panel and action buttons
* pause the **sleep timer** through Rumble's own player
* say the zero advertising ID needs Android 13
* send only watch progress events when they are kept
* skip the chat DTO walk while no chat switch is on

### Twitch

#### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* apply the **chat timestamps** clock only while the switch is on
* check the auto-claim's null chat mode is safe at patch time
* fail the patch when injected smali loses an instruction
* finish an avoided ad break when **Avoid stitched ads** is switched off
* give Fix notifications and **Fix stuck start screen** switches
* keep third-party badge holder IDs as 64-bit numbers
* leave chat and the player gear alone while their switches are off
* prove registers are dead before mid-method hooks write them
* refuse Hermes edits that a jump lands inside
* rename Amazon's suffix-form provider authorities in **Clone app**
* require a local before the **chat overlay** teardown hook uses v0
* take the Home tab list method's name from the match

#### 🔧 Improvements

* read React Native chat settings once per change, not per row
* reuse the prepared Hermes bundle when settings are unchanged

### Shared

#### ✨ New Features

* **settings:** add a Debug logging switch that gates Logger.d
* **settings:** redesign the Lurk settings screen
* **settings:** write the matched names to assets/lurk/locators.json

#### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **settings:** allow settings grouped under a choice
* **settings:** fail closed when the settings registry is unreadable
* **settings:** keep **Watch without signing in** on while Lurk is paused
* **settings:** refresh an existing launcher shortcut's label
* **settings:** run the **sleep timer**'s pause outside its bookkeeping lock

#### 🔧 Improvements

* **settings:** keep chat keyword lists until a setting changes
